project_info.theme: Fragrance note poster for Y Le Parfum
project_info.color_palette: Midnight blue, black, deep brown wood, cool green pine, white

main_subject.detail: A Y Le Parfum bottle lies diagonally over a dark natural set made of rugged wood bark and dense pine needles. Top text reads 'Y LE PARFUM' and 'CHẤT TÔI ĐIỀM TĨNH, TIÊN PHONG'. Additional callouts read 'TRẦM ẤM NHỰA THÔNG', 'TƯƠI MÁT PHONG LỮ', 'TRÀN ĐẦY NĂNG LƯỢNG LÁ KIM', and 'DA THỊT HOẮC HƯƠNG'.
main_subject.style: Luxury fragrance note poster, dark aromatic still life, editorial ingredient storytelling

composition_elements.text: Y LE PARFUM, CHẤT TÔI ĐIỀM TĨNH, TIÊN PHONG, TRẦM ẤM NHỰA THÔNG, TƯƠI MÁT PHONG LỮ, TRÀN ĐẦY NĂNG LƯỢNG LÁ KIM, DA THỊT HOẮC HƯƠNG
items: Top Left: Vertical YSL BEAUTE logo in white
Top Right: White product-title block and note callout 'TƯƠI MÁT PHONG LỮ'
Bottom Left: White ingredient callouts over rugged bark and dark background
Bottom Right: Dense pine needle cluster with the note callout 'TRÀN ĐẦY NĂNG LƯỢNG LÁ KIM'
Center/Background: Diagonally placed dark blue Y Le Parfum bottle over bark textures and pine foliage

lighting_and_atmosphere.effect: Cool highlights on lacquered glass, tactile bark textures, deep shadow pockets, nocturnal masculine mood

prompt.generated_prompt_string: [COMBINED PROMPT]: High quality square fragrance-note poster for YSL. Centerpiece is a dark Y Le Parfum bottle laid diagonally across rugged bark and dense pine foliage. Include the exact text 'Y LE PARFUM', 'CHẤT TÔI ĐIỀM TĨNH, TIÊN PHONG', 'TRẦM ẤM NHỰA THÔNG', 'TƯƠI MÁT PHONG LỮ', 'TRÀN ĐẦY NĂNG LƯỢNG LÁ KIM', and 'DA THỊT HOẮC HƯƠNG', plus the vertical YSL BEAUTE logo on the upper left. Technical style: photoreal fragrance-note advertising composite, moody directional studio lighting, tactile wood-and-pine texture and cool glass highlights, 8k resolution, highly detailed.
prompt.negative_prompt: dark, gloomy, blurry, flat 2d, low resolution, distorted text, messy typography, muted colors, black and white, ugly, deformed shapes, watermark, signature, cropped

assets.name: Y Le Parfum bottle
assets.usage: Preserve bottle geometry, blue-black lacquer tone, and silver Y-band detail

assets.name: Wood bark and pine foliage set
assets.usage: Match the bark grain, pine density, and diagonal set composition

assets.name: Fragrance-note callout layout
assets.usage: Keep the note words distributed around the bottle exactly as a scent-story map

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: This is a fragrance-note storytelling poster, not a plain packshot. Keep the diagonal bottle placement and the natural-material callouts tightly tied to the product.
